# IGovernanceRewardsManager
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/gov-contracts/src/interfaces/IGovernanceRewardsManager.sol)

IStakingRewardsManagerBase, [IGovernanceRewardsManagerErrors](../errors/i-governance-rewards-manager-errors.md)

**Title:**

Interface for the GovernanceRewardsManager contract

Manages staking and distribution of multiple reward tokens

## Events
### UnstakeOnBehalfOfIgnored
Emitted when unstakeAndWithdrawOnBehalfOf is called (operation not supported)


```solidity
event UnstakeOnBehalfOfIgnored(address indexed owner, address indexed receiver, uint256 amount);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`owner`|`address`|The address that owns the staked tokens|
|`receiver`|`address`|The address that would have received the unstaked tokens|
|`amount`|`uint256`|The amount of tokens that was attempted to be unstaked|
